about: A smoke run trained with the code before brains and deploy (main at a5b452f), with the config below in the old shape ([strategy] population 10, offspring 10; [budget] generations 4; [run] checkpoint_every 10; scenarios.generator 2, held_out_seed 2). The event log's digest is exact on the machine type it was pinned on (macOS arm64): the last bit of a float depends on the platform's libm and on the SIMD kernels numpy picks for the CPU. The evaluations' digest with every number to 9 significant digits is the same everywhere (checked on macOS arm64 and two Linux x86-64 machines).
config:
name = "pin"
[world.simulation]
max_steps = 200
[team]
agents = 10
[scenarios]
easy = 2
full = 2
held_out = 4
seed = 1
[evolution]
population = 10
generations = 4
[run]
backend = "numpy"
device = "cpu"
precision = "float64"
